rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow, jurisdiction-and-framework-focused opinion (standing/predominance/strict-scrutiny sequencing) vacating or reversing the district court without destabilizing Section 2, which points to an opinion by the Chief or Justice Barrett. Separate writings are most likely from Justice Thomas (to question Section 2 as a compelling interest and/or tighten standing) and from one or more justices to emphasize that Section 2 risk is not a blank check while preserving Milligan/Miller/Vera.
